name: Zoom Blur
description: Recreation of the CapCut "Zoom Blur" animation. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

params.name: progress
params.description: 0 = start of the in animation, 1 = the untouched clip. Use 1 - progress for an out animation

params.name: scale
params.description: Scale at progress 0 (1 = no zoom, below 1 grows in from small)

params.name: strength
params.description: Radial blur at progress 0, in parts of the distance to the centre
